description: Discover which OpenTrain public API features are enabled for this token (job drafting, publishing, hiring, messaging writes, team) plus accepted job-draft fields and enums. The result.agentSurfaces block reports every agent operation family as disabled, rollout_gated, unauthorized, or available with required vs granted scopes and per-operation authorized flags (a read-only token sees mutations as unauthorized even in an available family). Canonical-admin-restricted families (admin-balance hiring) additionally carry a `restricted` block with the live eligibility verdict (token_missing_scope | actor_ineligible | surface_disabled) and the exact safe remediation. Call this when a tool returns a feature-disabled or scope error, or before planning a multi-step flow.
name: opentrain_capabilities
